# Replace the filter

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series

![Replace the filter](../img/bin_600_900--filter.svg)

**What it does**

A filter loses its effect over time, even when it is tapped clean regularly.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release and pull the bin out.
2. Press the old filter down and lift it out.
3. Put the new filter in with the pleats facing the same way as the old one.
4. Slide the bin in until it clicks and report the filter as replaced.

> **Note** Use a filter made for this model: one that does not seal lets dust through.

## Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Replace the filter](../img/bin_600_900--filter.svg)

**What it does**

A filter loses its effect over time, even when it is tapped clean regularly.

**How to**

1. Take the bin out of the robot.
2. Press the tab of the filter door, lift the door and pull the old filter out by its yellow tab.
3. Put the new filter in with the pleats facing the same way and close the filter door.
4. Slide the bin in until it clicks and report the filter as replaced.

> **Note** Use a filter made for this model: one that does not seal lets dust through.

## Roomba e, i and j series, Combo j

![Replace the filter](../img/bin_eij--filter.svg)

**What it does**

A filter loses its effect over time, even when it is tapped clean regularly.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release on the back of the robot and take the bin out.
2. Grip the old filter at its sides and pull it out to the left.
3. Put the new filter in with the pleats facing the same way as the old one.
4. Slide the bin into its guide until it clicks and report the filter as replaced.

> **Note** Use a filter made for this model: one that does not seal lets dust through.

## Roomba s series

![Replace the filter](../img/bin_s--filter.svg)

**What it does**

A filter loses its effect over time, even when it is tapped clean regularly.

**How to**

1. Open the lid and lift the bin out by its handle.
2. Open the filter door and pull the old filter out by its loop.
3. Put the new filter in and close the filter door: it only closes with the filter seated correctly.
4. Put the bin back and report the filter as replaced.

> **Note** Use a filter made for this model: one that does not seal lets dust through.

## Prime robots and other models

![Replace the filter](../img/bin_eij--filter.svg)

**What it does**

A filter loses its effect over time, even when it is tapped clean regularly.

**How to**

1. Take the bin out of the robot.
2. Lift the old filter out by its tab.
3. Insert the new filter with the pleats facing the same way as the old one.
4. Slide the bin back in until it clicks, then mark the filter as replaced.

> **Note** Use a filter made for this model: one that does not seal lets dust through.
